details.name: Avywenna
details.quote: Well, well, look who it is — the legendary Endministrator. I picked up a couple of whispers on my way here. Curious to know which one's the most accurate? Since you don't know me well yet, here's my offer: how about I tell you a secret in exchange for a little something about you? Whaddya reckon?
details.infection: Oripathy negative, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Street Wisdom: Negotiator She has tagged a price for everything in this world, down to a single word, a single look, and a single thought.
details.exp2d: Agility: Bouncy Fighter Do not underestimate her skills. While dodging and evading the opponent, she is always ready to make a lightning-quick pounce.
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Life's Transit Points Not many people know that she enjoys making her lodgings as comfortable as possible. Even fewer know how many homes she actually owns.
details.hb2d: Fashion: Splurging on Jewelry It's not the shimmering glitter of jewelry, but the act of buying that brings her satisfaction. And she intends to truly spoil herself for this trip.
